fact: The minister stated on 17 November 2025 a target of 3G/4G completion by 2027 and total connectivity of the population by 2030, with 95 per cent of inhabited areas covered; no named broadband plan.
title: Déclaration de politique générale de Mark-Alexandre Doumba (WTDC-25)
publisher: Mission permanente de la République gabonaise, Genève
